title: Robust Concept Erasure via Kernelized Rate-Distortion Maximization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring probing accuracy, Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Generalized Demographic Parity (ΔGDP) after applying the KRaM concept erasure method to remove gender information from GloVe word embeddings and GPT-3.5 text representations.

Evaluating the erasure of racial attributes from tweet embeddings (DIAL dataset) and community demographic features (UCI Crimes dataset) by measuring probing classification accuracy, Demographic Parity (DP), and ΔGDP.

Measuring probing MSE and ΔGDP after applying vector-valued concept erasure to remove religious identity information (e.g., Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim) from GPT-3.5 representations on the Jigsaw toxicity dataset.

Evaluated alongside gender in the Jigsaw toxicity dataset by erasing a vector-valued concept containing categories such as 'bisexual', 'heterosexual', and 'homosexual, gay, or lesbian', measured via probing MSE and ΔGDP.
